## Applied Digital Achieves Initial 25 MW Ready for Service in Harwood, North Dakota, for Hyperscaler, Completes Base-Build Commissioning of First 75 MW


November 24, 2026 8:00am EST[Download as PDF](https://ir.applieddigital.com/_assets/_ff8f85f00ce3b0fe05da1f2f0239144d/appliedblockchaininc/news/2026-11-24_Applied_Digital_Achieves_Initial_25_MW_Ready_for_166.pdf)


### On-schedule Polaris Forge 2 milestone establishes the foundation for the next 50 MW of customer deliveries, reinforcing repeatable execution against more than $41 billion in contracted base-term lease revenue


DALLAS, Nov. 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Applied Digital (NASDAQ: APLD), a U.S. based AI data center infrastructure company specializing in the design, development, ownership and operation of large-scale, purpose-built campuses serving hyperscale off-takers under long-term contracts, today announced it has completed base-build commissioning for the first 75 MW of its initial 150 MW data center building at Polaris Forge 2 in Harwood, North Dakota. Within this phase, the Company has completed the integrated fit-out of the first 25 MW data hall and achieved Ready for Service on schedule.


The milestone marks the first Ready for Service achievement at Applied Digital’s second AI Factory campus, following the delivery of 250 MW operational critical IT load at Polaris Forge 1 in Ellendale, North Dakota. With the base-build infrastructure for the full 75 MW phase successfully tested and commissioned, the remaining 50 MW can now advance through fit-out and customer delivery.


“AI infrastructure demand is not theoretical for us. It’s backed by long-term customer commitments, and our focus is on delivering against them,” said Wes Cummins, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Applied Digital. “With our second campus now reaching Ready for Service on schedule, we’re demonstrating that our execution model is repeatable. The ability to consistently turn contracted demand into delivered AI capacity is what will define the leaders in this industry, and that’s exactly what we’re doing at Applied Digital.”


The building is fully leased as part of the customer’s 200 MW long-term lease at Polaris Forge 2, contributing to Applied Digital’s portfolio of more than $41 billion in contracted base-term lease revenue. Each 150 MW building at the AI Factory Campus is commissioned in two 75 MW phases, with three 25 MW data halls tested and commissioned together during each phase.


This achievement underscores Applied Digital’s ability to execute against contracted hyperscaler demand, applying consistent engineering standards, construction processes and operational expertise to deliver purpose-built AI infrastructure across multiple campuses.


**About Applied Digital**


Applied Digital (Nasdaq: APLD) is a U.S. based AI infrastructure company specializing in the design, development, ownership and operation of large-scale, purpose-built AI data center campuses.


Combining the fundamentals of technical real estate with the specialized requirements of digital infrastructure, the Company provides the mission-critical power, advanced liquid cooling and connectivity required to support artificial intelligence and high-performance computing workloads. Applied Digital’s AI Factory campuses are leased to hyperscale customers under long-term contracts, combining specialized infrastructure assets with predictable, long-term revenue streams.


Through its repeatable approach to design, development and operations, Applied Digital delivers highly engineered infrastructure designed to support the demanding requirements of AI computing at scale.
